id: Musuh pertama: Preman! Mereka bergantian menyerang, maksimal dua sekaligus
Pukulan terasa: hitstop, layar bergetar, percikan, terpental, juggle di udara, jatuh dan bangun (kebal sebentar)
Lompat + Pukul = Pukulan Melayang, Lompat + Tendang = Tendangan Terbang
en: First enemy: the Preman! They take turns, at most two attack at once
Hits feel heavy: hitstop, screen shake, sparks, knockback, air juggles, knockdown and get-up invincibility
Jump + Punch = Air Punch, Jump + Kick = Flying Kick
